Happy New Year! Sharing a faculty opportunity that may be of interest to the HCI / human-centered AI community:

Columbia University Department of Biomedical Informatics (DBMI) is recruiting an exceptional tenure-track faculty member at any rank (Assistant/Associate/Professor). The search is open to researchers developing and applying informatics theory with tangible benefits to health care and biology, with three highlighted areas:

· Machine learning for healthcare / health-related data science

· AI and technology-based interventions

· Translational bioinformatics

Apply here:
Feel free to share with others who might be a good fit. Happy to answer any questions.
